web_research.product_description: Series B data platform that helps mid-market retail teams unify store, ecommerce, inventory, and customer data for revenue planning.
web_research.target_market: Mid-market retail and commerce operators with distributed sales, merchandising, and analytics teams.
recent_news: Raised a $30M Series B ten months ago to expand product and go-to-market hiring
Hired Priya Shah as VP of Sales to build a repeatable mid-market revenue motion
Opened 12 sales roles across AE, SDR, and frontline sales management
Announced new retail forecasting dashboards for regional revenue teams

funding_rounds.investors: Ridge Ventures, Northstar Ventures, Operator Collective

funding_signals.hiring_signals: Harbor has about 140 employees, up roughly 38% year over year, with 12 open sales roles and no visible RevOps hire.
growth_indicators: New VP of Sales hired after the Series B
Sales headcount expansion is outpacing revenue-operations hiring
Recent product launches target regional retail revenue teams
Likely pressure to standardize forecasting, pipeline inspection, and handoffs before the team scales further

direct_competitors.name: RetailIQ
direct_competitors.overlap: Retail analytics and store performance dashboards

adjacent_competitors.name: Snowflake
adjacent_competitors.overlap: Data cloud and retail data workloads

competitive_landscape.differentiation: Harbor positions around retail-specific revenue workflows rather than generic BI. Their challenge is making that value obvious to sales teams as headcount grows.
competitive_landscape.market_position: Emerging Series B vendor in the retail analytics category, likely selling against broader BI platforms and vertical specialists.
